items.title: Kurt Campbell: US-China AI Talks Won't Limit Beijing
items.title_ko: Kurt Campbell: US-China AI Talks Won't Limit Beijing
items.summary_ko: Former Deputy Secretary of State Kurt Campbell says talks between Washington and Beijing on security and AI will struggle to yield binding limits due to mutual distrust. He adds substantive progress may have to wait for a potential meeting between President Trump and President Xi at APEC or the G20.

items.title: Trump & Xi to Meet Amidst Friction on Wars, Tech, Trade
items.title_ko: Trump & Xi to Meet Amidst Friction on Wars, Tech, Trade
items.summary_ko: US President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping prepare to meet in Washington with technological supremacy and unresolved economic friction at the top of the agenda. Ahead of an approaching trade truce deadline, discussions are likely to center on artificial intelligence competition, semiconductor export policy, and potential Chinese EV manufacturing in the US.
